proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: Our camelback in Germantown had three soft boards at the front edge of the porch. Odell replaced them, matched the old tongue-and-groove and painted them the same gray. You cannot tell which ones are new.
reviews.name: Hollis B.

reviews.text: Twelve-foot ceilings in Old Louisville and a wobbly fan. He brought a tall ladder, put in a proper fan brace and swapped the fan in under two hours. No more wobble.
reviews.name: Celeste W.

reviews.text: We booked the Derby-ready half day in March. Porch rail, screen door, two cracked balusters and a coat of paint on the steps, all done three weeks before the party.
reviews.name: Andre M.

reviews.text: The plaster in our stairwell had a crack running the whole height. They screwed it back with plaster washers, filled it and painted. It has stayed closed through a humid summer.
reviews.name: Frances L.

reviews.text: The wooden screen door on our shotgun house slammed every time and dragged on the sill. They squared the frame, put on a new closer, and now it shuts softly.
reviews.name: Marcus J.

reviews.text: Our back gate sagged so badly we tied it shut with rope. They reset the post in concrete and rebuilt the frame. It swings on its own and latches every time.
reviews.name: Diane C.

proof.guarantee: If a repair we made fails within a year, call us and we come back and fix it at no charge.

prices.note: a few boards up to a full front edge
